description: Classification mapping for classifications in source issues to respective target classification.

classifications.description: An object with the key as the ID of the target classification and value with the list of the IDs of the current source classifications.

issueType.description: ID of the source issueType to which issues present in `issueIdOrKeys` belongs.

projectKeyOrId.description: ID or key of the source project to which issues present in `issueIdOrKeys` belongs.
